data.long_meaning: Derived from the Polish name Ursz, meaning bear. Used in honor of Saint Ursula, a legendary princess who led an army of virgins against the Huns. The name Urszula carries the meaning “Little bear” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Urszula usually hope their child will grow to embody little bear and live with faith, good character and purpose.
